mapper.select: SELECT c.base_year_quarter_code AS baseYearQuarterCode, c.quarter_code AS quarterCode, c.admin_dong_code AS adminDongCode, c.service_industry_code AS serviceIndustryCode, r.commercial_change_code AS commercialChangeCode, c.operating_store_count AS operatingStoreCount, c.total_operating_store_count AS totalOperatingStoreCount, r.opening_rate AS openingRate, c.operating_franchise_store_ratio AS operatingFranchiseStoreRatio, c.competition_density AS competitionDensity, c.area_size AS areaSize, c.avg_monthly_income AS avgMonthlyIncome, c.food_expenditure_ratio AS foodExpenditureRatio, c.entertainment_expenditure_ratio AS entertainmentExpenditureRatio, c.education_expenditure_ratio AS educationExpenditureRatio, c.leisure_expenditure_ratio AS leisureExpenditureRatio, c.floating_pop_total_log AS floatingPopTotalLog, c.floating_pop_per_store AS floatingPopPerStore, c.young_pop_ratio AS youngPopRatio, c.weekend_pop_ratio AS weekendPopRatio, r.avg_operating_months AS avgOperatingMonths, r.avg_closure_months AS avgClosureMonths, r.op_months_vs_closure_avg AS opMonthsVsClosureAvg, r.operation_months_vs_seoul_avg AS operationMonthsVsSeoulAvg, r.avg_sales_per_transaction AS avgSalesPerTransaction, r.weekend_sales_ratio AS weekendSalesRatio, r.sales_missing_flag AS salesMissingFlag, r.sales_missing_type_code AS salesMissingTypeCode, r.closure_rate_lag1 AS closureRateLag1, c.closure_rate_change AS closureRateChange, c.total_store_count_change AS totalStoreCountChange, c.floating_pop_change AS floatingPopChange, r.opening_rate_lag1 AS openingRateLag1, r.avg_sales_per_transaction_lag1 AS avgSalesPerTransactionLag1 FROM REPORT_DATA_COMMON c JOIN REPORT_DATA_RISK r USING (base_year_quarter_code, admin_dong_code, service_industry_code) WHERE c.admin_dong_code = #{adminDongCode} AND c.service_industry_code = #{serviceIndustryCode} ORDER BY c.base_year_quarter_code DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPORT_DATA_PRED_RISK_RESULT ( base_year_quarter_code, admin_dong_code, service_industry_code, risk_prob, risk_closure_rate, risk_level, final_closure_rate, message, risk_ai_response, top1_feature_name, top1_feature_value, top1_impact, top1_direction, top2_feature_name, top2_feature_value, top2_impact, top2_direction, top3_feature_name, top3_feature_value, top3_impact, top3_direction, model_version ) VALUES ( #{baseYearQuarterCode}, #{adminDongCode}, #{serviceIndustryCode}, #{riskProb}, #{riskClosureRate}, #{riskLevel}, #{finalClosureRate}, #{message}, #{riskAiResponse}, #{top1FeatureName}, #{top1FeatureValue}, #{top1Impact}, #{top1Direction}, #{top2FeatureName}, #{top2FeatureValue}, #{top2Impact}, #{top2Direction}, #{top3FeatureName}, #{top3FeatureValue}, #{top3Impact}, #{top3Direction}, #{modelVersion} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE risk_prob = VALUES(risk_prob), risk_closure_rate = VALUES(risk_closure_rate), final_closure_rate = VALUES(final_closure_rate), risk_level = VALUES(risk_level), message = VALUES(message), risk_ai_response = VALUES(risk_ai_response), top1_feature_name = VALUES(top1_feature_name), top1_feature_value = VALUES(top1_feature_value), top1_impact = VALUES(top1_impact), top1_direction = VALUES(top1_direction), top2_feature_name = VALUES(top2_feature_name), top2_feature_value = VALUES(top2_feature_value), top2_impact = VALUES(top2_impact), top2_direction = VALUES(top2_direction), top3_feature_name = VALUES(top3_feature_name), top3_feature_value = VALUES(top3_feature_value), top3_impact = VALUES(top3_impact), top3_direction = VALUES(top3_direction), model_version = VALUES(model_version), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT base_year_quarter_code AS baseYearQuarterCode, admin_dong_code AS adminDongCode, service_industry_code AS serviceIndustryCode, risk_prob AS riskProb, risk_closure_rate AS riskClosureRate, risk_level AS riskLevel, final_closure_rate AS finalClosureRate, message AS message, risk_ai_response AS riskAiResponse, top1_feature_name AS top1FeatureName, top1_feature_value AS top1FeatureValue, top1_impact AS top1Impact, top1_direction AS top1Direction, top2_feature_name AS top2FeatureName, top2_feature_value AS top2FeatureValue, top2_impact AS top2Impact, top2_direction AS top2Direction, top3_feature_name AS top3FeatureName, top3_feature_value AS top3FeatureValue, top3_impact AS top3Impact, top3_direction AS top3Direction, model_version AS modelVersion, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM REPORT_DATA_PRED_RISK_RESULT WHERE base_year_quarter_code = #{baseYearQuarterCode} AND admin_dong_code = #{adminDongCode} AND service_industry_code = #{serviceIndustryCode}
